articles.title: Former BNY exec launches NUVA, bets tokenization will remake Wall Street
articles.snippet: NUVA launched this week with nearly $19 billion in tokenized real-world assets from Figure Technologies, aiming to bring regulated U.S. yield products into DeFi.

articles.title: JPMorgan says ether and altcoins won't catch up to bitcoin without a major network boom
articles.snippet: The bank said ether and the broader altcoin market continue to trail bitcoin as weak network activity, sluggish DeFi growth and limited real-world adoption weigh on investor demand.

articles.title: South Korean funeral company records $33M unrealized loss on leveraged ETH ETFs
articles.snippet: South Korea’s seventh-largest mutual aid company is currently sitting on a $33 million paper loss on its leveraged Ether ETF investment, following the crypto market downturn.

articles.title: AI Still Can't Beat the On-Call Engineer: Here's Why
articles.snippet: The best AI models can't yet beat the engineers they’re supposed to replace at fixing real-world problems, a new benchmark suggests.

articles.title: This Open-Source Phone AI Agent Sees, Hears and Acts—All Without Touching the Cloud
articles.snippet: Oppo's X-OmniClaw runs directly on your Android device, using the camera, screen, and microphone to execute real tasks inside real apps.
